flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (findNoticesForMhaNricUpload, findToppanNoticesForStage), framework/workflows/agencies/mha/{upload/helpers/MhaNricDataHelper, upload/jobs/MhaNricUploadJob, download/helpers/MhaNricDownloadHelper, download/jobs/MhaNricDownloadJob}, framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService, framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob, helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper}, framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{models/ToppanStage, jobs/ToppanUploadJob, helpers/ToppanUploadHelper}, framework/schedulers/{MhaDownloadJobsScheduler, NotificationJobsScheduler}, resources/{cron-schedules-prod.properties, application-prod.properties}. Other repos: not used. The old copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is ignored (stale)
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: Vault Code Split, Vault must run because the notice needs vehicle and owner info, Vault permission granted to the App Service (cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck. This is the hirer version of OCMS12.6/OCMS12.11: after the hirer 2nd letter (DN2) and the electronic reminder, a notice about to go to the 3rd letter (DR3) has its particulars checked (Epic OCMS8). The MHA NRIC check includes stages DN2 and DR3, touches only the current-offender row, and the MHA upload/download crons are enabled=true in prod. Gaps: (1) the DataHive FIN/UEN job is off in prod (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false) and the DataHive NRIC enrichment is off (cron.mhadownload.datahive=false); (2) no gate in the code makes the 3rd letter wait for the MHA result or for the electronic reminder to be sent; ordering comes only from the cron schedules (MHA upload 09:00/14:00/21:00, download 11:30/16:30/23:30, Toppan 00:15); (3) the eNotification job is off (cron.notification.enabled=false) and a company hirer gets no email at DN2; (4) the stage advances to DR3 even if the DN2 file never reached the vendor because the delivery gate is bypassed (OCMS-DF-2026-192). The MHA file exchange, the DataHive view content and Vault cannot be verified from repo. Tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-177 (Closed; current offender only), OCMS-DF-2026-133 (remark: the MHA cron was not yet switched on in PRD at that time; real value cannot be verified), OCMS-DF-2026-176 (Ready to UAT; owner_driver timestamp), OCMS-DF-2026-192, OCMS-DF-2026-180.
recommendation: Claim partially. The MHA NRIC selector and the current-offender particulars update exist and are on in the prod properties; the DataHive FIN/UEN path is off, the electronic reminder does not run in prod and nothing holds back the 3rd letter. Ask for proof that the MHA crons are active in PRD and for a URA decision on a gate

steps.step: OCMS has already sent the electronic reminder to the hirer (referring to the 2nd letter) before the check
steps.detail: The reminder is sent by the eNotification job (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1076-1121 selects last stage DN2; NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:289-292 for individual SMS). Sebagian because cron.notification.enabled=false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:236 (the scheduler skips execution, NotificationJobsScheduler.java:30-31 and 49-52), sms.enable=false in prod (application-prod.properties:87), and for a company hirer at DN2 the email content is deliberately skipped (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:311-318; NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:378-384). No code makes 'reminder already sent' a precondition before the MHA check or the 3rd letter. Per-channel detail is in OCMS12.27 to OCMS12.29.

steps.step: OCMS checks whether the hirer has opted out of electronic reminders
steps.detail: The reminder query drops IDs that are in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1131-1134) and the job skips those IDs with the preloaded list (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:194, 226-232). An opt-out is honoured: no reminder is sent and the notice continues on the letter track. Sebagian because this check only runs when the eNotification job is active (cron.notification.enabled=false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:236 (the scheduler skips execution, NotificationJobsScheduler.java:30-31 and 49-52)). No code makes the 3rd letter wait for this check. How an ID gets on the exclusion list and its content: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS selects the hirer notices heading for the 3rd letter (stage DN2/DR3) to check their particulars with MHA (NRIC holders)
steps.detail: findNoticesForMhaNricUpload selects notices with next_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), next_processing_date <= tomorrow, suspension_type IS NULL, id_type = 'N', offender_indicator = 'Y', not in ocms_nro_temp and whose ID is not in ocms_hst (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:556-581). The helper calls this query (MhaNricDataHelper.java:77-81) and MhaNricUploadJob builds the enquiry file from the result (MhaNricUploadJob.java:156). So a hirer whose notice is at DN2/DR3 is included. Schedule: cron.mhaupload.schedule=0 0 9,14,21 ? * MON-SAT, enabled=true (cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106). The story condition about the reminder being sent or an opt-out is not checked in this query. The file exchange with MHA: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The latest particulars of an NRIC-holding hirer from MHA are received and updated (name, date of birth/death, life status, address) on the current-offender record
steps.detail: MhaNricDownloadJob reads the result file (processResponseFile, MhaNricDownloadJob.java:556) and then applyStatusUpdates (MhaNricDownloadJob.java:633; MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:484-486). It updates name, lifeStatus, dateOfBirth, dateOfDeath and the mha_reg address only on rows with offender_indicator = 'Y' (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:777-779 and 834-840), in line with OCMS-DF-2026-177 (Closed). The download job is enabled=true in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:119-120). Sebagian because the NRO file exchange with MHA and the result file content cannot be verified from repo; the OCMS-DF-2026-133 remark says the MHA cron was not yet switched on in PRD at that time while the properties say enabled=true (real value cannot be verified); OCMS-DF-2026-176 (owner_driver timestamp not updated) is still Ready to UAT.

steps.step: The particulars of FIN-holding and company (UEN) hirers are checked and updated through DataHive
steps.detail: DataHiveUenFinService selects notices with next_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type IS NULL, id_type IN ('F','B'), offender_indicator = 'Y' (DataHiveUenFinService.java:222-246), so FIN/UEN hirers at DN2/DR3 are included. But MhaDownloadJobsScheduler skips the second job when cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false (MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.java:43 and 103-107) and the value is false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52, comment: wait until the DataHive view names are verified). So in the prod configuration FIN/UEN hirers are not checked. The content of the DataHive (DOS) view cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: After the hirer 2nd letter is processed, the notice moves to stage DR3 (3rd letter)
steps.detail: ToppanStage has DN1 -> DN2 -> DR3 (ToppanStage.java:22-23). resolveStageContext takes next_processing_stage from ocms_stage_map and falls back to the enum (DN2 -> DR3) when empty (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1814-1820). Sebagian because the stage advances even if the DN2 file never reached the vendor: confirmDeliveryAndAdvanceStage bypasses the delivery gate while sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-444; OCMS-DF-2026-192, Ready to UAT). The ocms_stage_map rows in the DB: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: A checked hirer can be sent the 3rd letter; a notice suspended by the check result is not processed
steps.detail: The Toppan query for stage DR3 only takes notices with suspension_type IS NULL (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:608-611), so a notice given PS or TS-NRO by the MHA result is not printed (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:872-880 and 1118-1130). But no gate in the code makes the 3rd letter wait for the MHA result or for the reminder to be sent: the Toppan query does not look at ocms_nro_temp and ordering comes only from the cron schedules (MHA upload 09:00/14:00/21:00, download 11:30/16:30/23:30, Toppan 00:15; cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62, 105, 119). If the MHA result file is late, a DR3 notice is still processed with the old address. Building and sending the 3rd letter itself is the scope of OCMS12.31; there the letter only runs through the manual trigger and the upload to Toppan is blocked (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:151-154; ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118).
